title: Performance of Yoshinogawa STP, Japan (FY 2009

cell_spans.description: Printed group heading 'BOD, mg/L' spans three value columns (Influent, Effluent, % Removal)
Printed group heading 'SS, mg/L' spans three value columns
Printed group heading 'TN, mg/L' spans three value columns

notes: Source: Regional Sewerage Centre of Nara Prefecture, Japan, 2009
Printed as 'Table 5.31  Performance of Yoshinogawa STP, Japan (FY 2009' with no closing parenthesis; not corrected.

Transcriber layout note: the table has two printed header levels. The upper level carries the three pollutant group headings; the single lower-left cell reads 'Influent / Effluent / % Removal' and fixes the order of the three values under each group. No separate Influent/Effluent/Removal labels are printed above the values.
Water quality values are otherwise unlabelled by unit apart from the group headings (BOD, SS and TN in mg/L).

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page render and 300-420 dpi crops; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: Group headings, the order label and all nine values read from a 300 dpi crop. Value order verified against the printed 'Influent / Effluent / % Removal' label.
